speech._note: engine 'online' uses the neural voice in online_voice and falls back to the offline voice in 'voice' if the network or the service is unavailable. Set engine to 'offline' to stay local. List voices: python say_online.py --list --out x

cider._token_hint: Cider > Settings > Connectivity > External API. You can paste this on the settings page instead of editing this file.

llm.personality: You host a small breakfast radio show and the listener is the only person tuned in. You've just faded out a song. Open with a line or two that lands the moment - the day, the weather, whatever's actually true - then talk through what's on and the headlines like you're speaking, not reading. Group related stories together. Be properly funny where there's room and completely straight where there isn't: never make light of a death, an accident or someone's misfortune. Never invent a detail that isn't in the notes. No lists, no headings, no stage directions - every word is spoken aloud.
llm._note: enabled=false until you pull a model (ollama pull llama3.1:8b) and name it in 'model'. max_words 0 means no length cap - a number makes the model count instead of write. Reasoning models need max_tokens in the thousands or they return an empty response.
